content.short: Mobile App Gallery For Cardano NFTs.
content.description:
Discover what's behind the doors and explore our collection, crafted with love and designed to serve as a funding round for realising our vision of the future of Cardano NFTs.

NFT Craze is a project that started out as an expression of our admiration for Cardano and the sheer joy involved in making art. We are a UK-based team of software engineers and designers that aim to reach as many of you as we can and leave a mark on your lives (as well as on the Cardano blockchain haha). Since its beginnings, the project has grown organically into an ambitious roadmap that includes projects such as NFT-Craze Gallery – the first mobile application to allow its users to view all of their Cardano NFTs in one place.

Our roadmap also includes developing a peer-to-peer marketplace that will facilitate sales and auctions of Cardano NFTs, as well as supporting artists with launching their own collections on the Cardano blockchain through our infrastructure.

Doors To Beyond is what really started it all, our pride and joy, and would act as a funding round to realise our vision.

So join us on this journey and let’s take this NFT craze by storm!
